# vMLX 1.6.82

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.81 updater manifest (`c8fba0d2`)
- Load stored affine DFlash2 drafts and validate bundled weight admission (`30025c02`)
- Keep Qwen MoE DFlash targets on native kernels by default (`b39256fb`)
- Show effective speculative status without unmeasured speed claims (`775aceb1`)
- Validate bundled DSpark weights before selecting its runtime (`662eaa6a`)
- Honor request cache bypass in speculative and media serving (`4542eb09`)
- Preserve shared chat selection across session views (`6132096e`)
- Refresh adaptive DFlash AR baseline for each request (`00b6c35b`)
- Add DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (deepseek_v41) model family (`056fc39e`)
- DSV4.1: robust tokenizer load + native chat encoder shim (`29c1d8c3`)
- DSV4.1: classify composite cache as non-hybrid + internal integration doc (`4da214b4`)
- DSV4.1: don't let the DSV4 generator sniff match deepseek_v41 (`bf5199c8`)
- DSV4.1: disk-only SSD prompt-boundary cache reuse (DSV4-parity) (`cff8be2d`)
- dsv41: in-app multimodal (image) serving via text-routed VL path (`fed8ea69`)
- dsv41: native V4.1 DSML tool calls (parser + prompt render + fallback detection) (`7ca9ece4`)
- panel: recognize deepseek_v41 so mlxstudio loads the V4.1 JANG bundle natively (`7592b013`)
- dsv41(engine): load bundle dSpark MTP draft, attach as model._dspark (`7dcff176`)
- dsv41(engine): wire V4.1 DSpark speculative decode into the SBG path (`bf1ce697`)
- panel: DeepSeek-V4.1 in-app tool calls use the native deepseek_v41 parser (`75c97668`)
- dsv41(engine): hybrid DSpark + prefix-cache coexistence (`7acb0fcf`)
- dsv41(engine): keep hybrid DSpark+prefix-cache; document the paged-reconstruction finding (`0da8cab5`)
- dsv41: DSpark + prefix-cache reuse TOGETHER (fix snapshot clone for 4-bit pools) (`d4d0d689`)
- dsv41: DSpark adaptive speculative decode default-ON (50+ tok/s easy code) (`7fe5f926`)
- dsv41: pass VL images to the DSpark generator (isinstance, not exact class-name match) (`730d3313`)
- dsv41: pass the next prefill chunk as engram_lookahead (`bfe5dbc1`)
- dsv41: snapshot at the exact N-1 prompt boundary; DSpark only for greedy (`4dd64d24`)
- dsv41: bit-exact 4-bit prompt snapshots; typed DSV4.1 disk restore (`2d07dd73`)
- dsv41: log DSpark governor stats (spec/AR steps, ms per token) per request (`6d9299df`)
- dsv41 tests: scope the CPU default device to each test (`2d6dbf56`)
- dsv41 VL: images in their own turns, chunk-relative splicing, media-salted prefix reuse (`f1e2b3be`)
- dsv41: CLI policy, V4.1-only tool-parser encoder, DSV4 sniff; stale comments (`9f8ffa6f`)
- dsv41: DSpark boundary snapshots carry the draft-window seed (`ff359ba5`)
- dsv41 VL: cache-free insert retry keeps the images (`676ab961`)
- dsv41 tests: fake runtimes accept engram_lookahead; assert DSpark prefill lookahead (`135d8ca8`)
- dsv41: 16 GB allocator-cache floor for DeepSeek-V4.1 serving (`8f0adbaf`)
- dsv41: 1024-token prefill chunks while the DSpark draft is resident (`5539fe2e`)
- docs: DeepSeek-V4.1 engine integration (generator selection, prefill memory settings, prefix-cache format, VL keys, tests) (`52c4b491`)
- dsv41: scheduler stats name the DSpark generator (path dsv41_dspark) instead of 'custom'; include its snapshot telemetry (`20f5898f`)
- row-exact QMV: accept MLX 0.32.4's qmv_fast traversal (`c88be2d4`)
- docs: DSV4.1 decode notes (in-place commit, fp32 head, near-tie identity, row-exact QMV status) and measured KV bytes (`23a5d6e9`)
- docs: DSV4.1 served cold prefill after the group-major wo_a (822/933/872 pp/s) (`44998e7a`)
- docs: DSV4.1 KV measured at 1M; long-context prefill uses dsa_pool_index_scores (`e41638d5`)
- metal: DSA pool index scores on the M5 matrix units (dsa_index_scores_mpp) (`3b9e0e6d`)
- dsv41: dsa_pool_index_scores prefers the matrix-unit kernel for bf16 operands (`391ea34f`)
- docs: DSV4.1 long-context prefill on the matrix-unit index kernel (`3cefcc98`)
- dsv41: pass prompt_end to prefill chunks (runtime suffix pruning) (`a9b85c7a`)
- docs: DSV4.1 suffix pruning wiring and fused decode kernels; serving 845/1331/1554 pp/s, code 90 tok/s (`e1c828fd`)
- dsv41: drop an unused import; doc summary of the speed-critical engine pieces (`ac24e7f7`)
- JANGT: sub-2-bit trellis units (K=1, K=1.5) and masked tail blocks (`a96b3bf3`)
- JANGT: grouped few-row decode (each expert decoded once per pass of the rows routed to it) (`c50567e3`)
- JANGT: grouped decode route off by default (measured 2.7x slower than v3 on DeepSeek-V4.1) (`48f6c322`)
- metal: multi-row mxfp8 QMV (each weight read and decoded once for 3..7 rows, rows bit-identical to M=1) (`b3216a8c`)
- server: DeepSeek-V4.1 DSML markers start streaming tool buffering (`a017f5a4`)
- DeepSeek-V4.1: advertise vision in /capabilities; V4-0731 top-p advisory not shown for V4.1 (`e8b5c04d`)
- responses: serve DeepSeek-V4.1 images (text-routed VL) like /v1/chat/completions (`f96dc158`)
- JANGT: fused routed + mxfp8 shared-expert MoE decode in four dispatches (rows bit-identical to the stock path) (`283e94a5`)
- dsv41: DSpark serves sampled requests (exact sampled speculation), not only greedy (`cbddc1e3`)
- cache records: DeepSeek-V4 state rows bounded by the cache offset, not the 256K dim cap (`14dcf743`)
- tests: DeepSeek-V4.1 /v1/responses image tests run without an async test plugin (`dd607f4d`)
- cache records: long-context DeepSeek-V4 disk headers (dsv4 state rows bounded by the cache offset) (`da5c6a64`)
- docs: DeepSeek-V4.1 prefix-cache reuse at 924k tokens (RAM 5.8 s, SSD after restart 6.5 s) (`394cc5de`)
- Keep replayed empty assistant turns when the chat template renders them (`24703ef5`)
- Keep the empty assistant turn through extraction and the thinking-off strip (`f9b9686e`)
- dsv41 DSpark: greedy means temperature 0, not accepts_logits (`87757468`)
- Chat template retry drops extra kwargs before tools (`efe297bd`)
- dsv41: normalize reasoning effort to the encoder's numeric budget (`696712b4`)
- DSV4.1 / JANGT review follow-ups: jang pin, guarded SpecSampler, self-check key, grouped-decode removal (`4e5464e1`)
- dsv41: store DeepseekV41Cache in the RAM prefix cache (`85bbc906`)
- dsv41: split V4.0-only cache policies off DeepseekV41Cache (`d6d3600b`)
- dsv41: drop unreachable hybrid entry, isinstance generator check (`2f11bccb`)
- dsv41 docs: sampled DSpark, effort ladder, cache policy, flags (`157fe581`)
- dsv41: keep class-name generator check, document why (`b3539b17`)
- DSV4.1 DSpark generator reports prefill progress to the stream guard (`ddceaade`)
- deps: jang source pin f7849d4e -> 64231a4 (jangq main: DSV4.1 cleanup, sampled-noise fix, decode kernels) (`f7f96e3b`)
- Pin jang-tools to jangq main 64231a41 (DSV4.1 decode kernels) (`3082a46e`)
- Pin jang-tools to jangq main 05074cea (DSV4.1 one-dispatch routing) (`10d52700`)
- Prepare vMLX 1.6.82 with DeepSeek V4.1 and matched JANG runtime (`aae19a47`)
- Anthropic Messages: report the stop sequence that ended a generation (`3d5fe41c`)
- DSV4.1: required / named tool_choice adds the latest_reminder the Swift runtime sends (`a9b9c124`)
- panel: DSV4.1 bundles with encoding.py honor the thinking toggle (`e5f69698`)
- Pin jang-tools to jangq main b3d21c2f (dSpark governor: ratio of EMAs) (`21cc4dd3`)
- DSV4.1 DSpark: a prompt that fits in one 2048-token chunk prefills as one chunk (`2c917f6e`)
- DSV4.1 CLI: index the prefix cache the way the app launches V4.1 (`dc066163`)
- tests: prefill fakes carry dsv41_vl_images (`d16382f3`)
- DSV4.1: the required tool_choice reminder goes before the turn it applies to (`58ad55b3`)
- Align 1.6.82 package runtime with retained V4.1 governor proof (`8c500e0a`)
- Support approved DeepSeek two-format checkpoint evidence (`ed4ad507`)
- Wire scoped private evidence into signed candidate workflow (`7721b8aa`)
- DSV4.1: no injected tool_choice reminder; tool_choice handled like other models (`b3ea4f21`)
- Describe native tool-choice validation in release notes (`527684ea`)
